description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions related to type annotations, source code parsing, and runtime type inference for TorchScript. It includes classes like Module and EvalEnv, functions for parsing type comments, and mechanisms for converting annotations to internal type representations.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a module with a name and members, providing attribute access to its members.

classes.name: EvalEnv
classes.description: Provides an environment for evaluating type annotations with access to torch, typing, and other relevant objects.

methods.name: get_signature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a function or method, considering annotations and type comments.

methods.name: is_function_or_method
methods.description: Checks if a callable is a user-defined function or method, excluding built-in functions.

methods.name: is_vararg
methods.description: Determines if a function or method accepts variable arguments.

methods.name: get_param_names
methods.description: Gets parameter names for a function or method, handling class callables.

methods.name: check_fn
methods.description: Validates that a function is a top-level function and not a class instantiation.

methods.name: _eval_no_call
methods.description: Evaluates a statement without any function or method calls.

methods.name: parse_type_line
methods.description: Parses a type annotation comment into argument and return types.

methods.name: get_type_line
methods.description: Finds the line containing a type annotation comment in source code.

methods.name: split_type_line
methods.description: Splits a type comment into argument and return type parts.

methods.name: try_real_annotations
methods.description: Attempts to extract type annotations from a function's signature.

methods.name: try_ann_to_type
methods.description: Converts a Python annotation to an internal TorchScript type.

methods.name: ann_to_type
methods.description: Converts an annotation to a TorchScript type, raising if unknown.
